prompt:
You maintain a running summary of a long engineering document that is being read part by part, so that a later reader can model the system in SysML v2 without seeing the earlier parts.
Update the summary with the new part. Keep, as compactly as possible: the full names of system elements, actors and items; every alias or call sign with the full name it stands for; which element produces, sends or receives which item; modes and normative requirements. At most 300 words.

Current summary:
Caldera Wildfire Detection and Suppression Support System: advisory WUI decision support; continuity over automation when comms/power/sensors impaired. Caldera Incident Command Portal (Emberhall): triages above-threshold cases; marks radio route impaired on bridge failure (Orion ack); jurisdiction constraints before Drone Pilot Operator briefing; produces Crew Staging Pin (time, accuracy, incident ID); promotes accepted fire location to Redtail; assignment packages (objective, validity, acks); flags assignments on Confirmed Ignition State change; extended attack mode preserves aviation decisions; disconnected mode: last-sync marking, cached review, queued updates, no irreversible releases; named accounts, RBAC, MFA; auth outage uses expiring signed credentials, supervisor review after. Airspace Restricted State: helitack boundary confirmation before aircraft movement. North/South Lookout Camera Masts: heartbeat/temperature/storage/pointing telemetry; North sends smoke bearing, Thermal Spot Snippet to Orion; South bearing, Camera Cleaning Log to Smoke Classifier. Horizon Ridge Drone Dock (Kestrel): Battery Swap Ticket to Drone Pilot Operator; no crew movement authority. Drone Tasking Service: mission status; not flight-release authority; no Marigold lane conflict; validates corridor permit before automated task in degraded comms. Sentinel Fireline Analytics Engine (Lantern): traceable recommendations, score not declaration; perimeter, probability bands; applies Ridge Shadow Mask; keeps last approved model, rejects unsigned. Smoke Classifier Module: plume confidence to Lantern; produces Ridge Shadow Mask; never sole aircraft basis; advisory if mast down or low image quality. MesoWest Weather Fusion Node (Brindle): Wind Shift Bulletin to Redtail; local cache. VHF Radio Gateway Repeater (Badger): fallback relay; queues acks ≥15 min on backhaul loss. Crewline Mobile Tablet: objectives, hazards, route, rally point; hides expired packages; encrypted update queue keeping author/device/server times. Talon Air Tanker Dispatch Console (Marigold): blocks incomplete releases; Runway Release Note; Suppression Drop Receipt. East/West Retardant Loading Pumps: East sends Retardant Batch Slip to Tanker Base Manager, metered recirculation mode; West shift-change inspection. Least privilege; separate admin approval; append-only signed audit, buffered offline; maintenance records before status change. Actors: County Emergency Liaison (Drone Corridor Permit); Duty Detection Officer (Orion); Air Attack Supervisor; Tanker Base Manager; Helitack Crew Leader; Drone Pilot Operator.

New part:
S197: Operational records that support command decisions and safety reviews shall be retained for the incident record period defined by agency policy, while high-volume raw sensor data may follow a shorter approved retention schedule.
S198: The system shall protect retained data with encryption at rest, controlled export procedures, and deletion workflows that require documented authorization.
S199: For incidents lasting multiple operational periods, spare power, replacement network equipment, field cleaning supplies, and documented recovery procedures shall be staged so that no single equipment fault stops detection or suppression-support operations.
S200: Training for the Caldera Wildfire Detection and Suppression Support System shall be completed before each fire season and refreshed whenever operating procedures or field configurations change.
S201: The training program shall be role based so that each participant practices the decisions, system functions, communications, and safety constraints that apply to the assigned position.
S202: The Duty Detection Officer shall be trained to operate the Caldera Incident Command Portal, review detections, validate confidence indicators, and escalate suspected ignitions according to the approved incident workflow.
S203: Camera familiarization shall cover the North Lookout Camera Mast and the South Lookout Camera Mast, including normal image behavior, degraded visibility conditions, routine inspection cues, and reporting of equipment faults.
S204: The Duty Detection Officer shall also learn how the Sentinel Fireline Analytics Engine and the Smoke Classifier Module present uncertainty so that human confirmation remains part of every operational decision.
S205: The Drone Pilot Operator shall be trained on Horizon Ridge Drone Dock procedures, Drone Tasking Service mission controls, safe launch checks, recovery actions, and loss-of-link coordination.
S206: The Air Attack Supervisor shall be trained to interpret system status during aerial operations and to coordinate with the Talon Air Tanker Dispatch Console without bypassing airspace safety requirements.
S207: The Tanker Base Manager shall receive practical instruction on status entry, loading coordination, and abnormal-condition reporting for the East Retardant Loading Pump and the West Retardant Loading Pump.
S208: The Helitack Crew Leader shall be trained on use of the Crewline Mobile Tablet, field acknowledgments, location updates, and communication discipline during changing fire behavior.
S209: During field mobilization drills, the Helitack Crew Leader shall use the staging pin to confirm that the assigned crew is positioned at the exercise location.
S210: The County Emergency Liaison shall be trained to interpret public-safety information from the Caldera Incident Command Portal and to coordinate notifications with county procedures.

Return JSON {"summary": "..."}.
